sinopsis.es: En un mundo consumido por la oscuridad, una interferencia fantasmal transmite la historia de dos almas que, en su último acto de amor, realizan un conjuro para convertirse en la llama de una vela.
sinopsis.en: In a world eaten by darkness, a ghostly interference conveys the tale of two souls who, in their final act of love, cast a spell to become a candle: An eternal flame that defies the infinite gloom. Through the distorted echo, its light flickers like a whisper of resistance in an endless abyss.
